cohort: Seven newborns with myelomeningoceles who experienced unsuccessful primary closure attempts (fetoscopic, postnatal, or revision surgeries) and subsequently required acellular dermal regeneration templates (ADRT) for complex repair.
finding: Acellular dermal regeneration templates (ADRT) can aid in wound healing and protect dural repair in myelomeningoceles, offering a viable option for complex or failed primary closures with limited donor tissue.
followup_time: At least 3 weeks post-ADRT placement, until complete wound epithelialization.
gest_age: Median delivery age of 37 weeks (IQR: 33-37 weeks)
